Fixture: kpmg.com-style OneTrust (reject-all reloads the page)

Mirrors the real kpmg.com OneTrust deployment confirmed live on 2026-09-06: a top-level banner with its own "Reject All Optional Cookies" button (#onetrust-reject-all-handler), plus a full preference center with its own reject-all button (.ot-pc-refuse-all-handler) and a "Confirm My Choices" save button (.save-preference-btn-handler). On the real site, clicking EITHER reject-all button correctly writes the OptanonConsent cookie and then reloads the page — confirmed by driving the real DOM directly (see docs/cmp-impact-map.md's KPMG section). Confirm My Choices does not reload.
